Each score must be a non-negative integer other than `bool`. `width` must be an integer other than `bool` and must be at least 20. There must be at least two periods; otherwise raise `ValueError`. Preserve row order and do not mutate the tuple. With no rows, the result contains only the two borders and title. Do not print from the function.

import unittest
from solution import render_scoreboard


class RenderScoreboardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_rendering_exactly(self):
        result = render_scoreboard((("Alice", 12), ("B", 0)), 20)
        self.assertEqual(result, "====================\n     SCOREBOARD     \nAlice.............12\nB..................0\n====================")
        self.assertTrue(all(len(line) == 20 for line in result.splitlines()))

    def test_default_width_and_row_order(self):
        rows = (("first", 2), ("second", 1))
        result = render_scoreboard(rows)
        lines = result.splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(lines[0], "=" * 36)
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "=" * 36)
        self.assertEqual(lines[1], "SCOREBOARD".center(36))
        self.assertTrue(lines[2].startswith("first"))
        self.assertTrue(lines[3].startswith("second"))
        self.assertTrue(all(len(line) == 36 for line in lines))

    def test_empty_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_scoreboard((), 20), "=" * 20 + "\n" + "SCOREBOARD".center(20) + "\n" + "=" * 20)

    def test_exact_two_period_boundary_and_insufficient_space(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_scoreboard((("x" * 17, 7),), 20).splitlines()[2], "x" * 17 + "..7")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            render_scoreboard((("x" * 18, 7),), 20)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            render_scoreboard((("x" * 17, 10),), 20)

    def test_type_validation(self):
        invalid_calls = [
            lambda: render_scoreboard([]),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", 1),), True),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", 1),), 20.0),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((["a", 1],), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard(((1, 1),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", True),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", 1.0),), 20),
        ]
        for call in invalid_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                call()

    def test_value_validation_and_non_mutation(self):
        invalid_calls = [
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("", 1),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a\nb", 1),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a\rb", 1),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", -1),), 20),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a", 1),), 19),
            lambda: render_scoreboard((("a",),), 20),
        ]
        for call in invalid_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                call()
        rows = (("stable", 4),)
        render_scoreboard(rows, 20)
        self.assertEqual(rows, (("stable", 4),))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
